doc.title: Al Gafa interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, May 2, 2023

title: Practicing technique from clarinet and violin books
summary: He focused on clean technique using clarinet and violin books rather than songs.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Learning your horn: teachers, lessons and fees

blocks.x: That’s a terrific answer. I understand what you’re saying. And when you say you were practicing at that time, what did a practice session normally include for you? Did you focus on one song at a time or learning new chords?

I focused on technique. I used to read out of clarinet technique books and violin technique books. The clarinet is right in the center range on the guitar, it’s really, you can easily incorporate the guitar literature with clarinet literature. And so I would be working on technique. I would be working to get the cleanest technique that I could get, you know if I played a note I wanted the note to come out.
